challenges.title: Editing Pages via Chat
challenges.description: As a user, I want to edit pages in my book through chat with Naomi.
challenges.instructions:
## The Story

As a user writing a book, I want to ask Naomi (the AI agent) to edit an existing page. I'll write in the chat something like:

> "Naomi, update the page 'New Morning' - change the character's name to Dana"

Naomi will understand the request, find the correct page, and update it.

## What Should Happen

- User writes a request in chat
- Naomi identifies this as an edit request
- Naomi finds the relevant page
- Naomi updates the content
- The updated content is saved and displayed

## Technical Background

Implementation requires:
- API route that receives instructions and performs updates
- Connection to OpenAI with function calling
- State and localStorage updates
successCriteria: Edit request in chat updates the page
Changes appear immediately on screen
Changes persist after refresh

challenges.title: Adding New Pages to Book
challenges.description: As a user, I want to ask Naomi to add a new page to my book through chat.
challenges.instructions:
## The Story

As a user writing a book, I want to ask Naomi to add a new page. I'll write in the chat:

> "Naomi, add a new page to chapter one - a scene in a coffee shop where Ronit meets an old friend"

Naomi will understand the request, write the content, and add it to the correct chapter.

## What Should Happen

- User describes the page they want
- Naomi understands which chapter to add it to
- Naomi writes appropriate content in the book's style
- The new page is added and displayed

## Technical Background

Implementation requires:
- Extending function calling to add pages
- Content creation by AI
- State update with the new page
successCriteria: Chat request creates a new page
Content is written in the book's style
Page is added to the correct chapter

challenges.title: Deleting Pages via Chat
challenges.description: As a user, I want to ask Naomi to delete a page from my book through chat.
challenges.instructions:
## The Story

As a user writing a book, sometimes I want to delete a page that no longer fits. I'll write in the chat:

> "Naomi, delete the page 'Morning View' from chapter one"

Naomi will ask for confirmation, and after I confirm - she'll delete the page.

## What Should Happen

- User requests to delete a page in chat
- Naomi identifies the relevant page
- Naomi asks for confirmation before deletion
- After confirmation, the page is deleted
- The change is saved and displayed

## Technical Background

Implementation requires:
- Adding a delete tool to function calling
- Confirmation mechanism in chat
- State and localStorage updates
successCriteria: Delete request in chat initiates the process
Naomi asks for confirmation before deletion
Page is deleted after confirmation
Change persists after refresh

challenges.title: Naomi Continues the Story
challenges.description: As a user, I want to ask Naomi to continue writing my story in the existing style.
challenges.instructions:
## The Story

As a user writing a book, I want Naomi to continue writing my story. I'll write in the chat:

> "Naomi, continue the page 'New Morning' - add a scene where Ronit leaves the house and meets the neighbor"

Naomi will read the existing content, understand the style, and continue writing harmoniously.

## What Should Happen

- User requests story continuation
- Naomi reads the existing content
- Naomi identifies the writing style
- Naomi writes appropriate continuation
- New content is added to the page

## Technical Background

Implementation requires:
- Passing context (existing content) to AI
- System prompt that guides the style
- Function calling to update the page
successCriteria: Chat request triggers automatic writing
New content matches existing style
Naomi maintains consistency with characters and plot
Content updates on the correct page

challenges.title: Naomi Reads the Story Aloud
challenges.description: As a user, I want to ask Naomi to read the current page aloud.
challenges.instructions:
## The Story

As a user reading a book, sometimes I want to listen instead of read. I'll write in the chat:

> "Naomi, read me the current page"

Naomi will read the text in a pleasant voice with proper pronunciation.

## What Should Happen

- User requests reading in chat
- Naomi identifies the current page
- Naomi activates voice reading
- User can stop the reading

## Technical Background

Implementation requires:
- Connection to ElevenLabs API
- API route for text-to-audio conversion
- Function calling to activate reading
successCriteria: Chat request activates reading
Reading has proper pronunciation
Reading can be stopped
Visual indication that Naomi is reading

challenges.title: Naomi Reviews Your Writing
challenges.description: As a user, I want to ask Naomi to review my writing and give feedback on style and consistency.
challenges.instructions:
## The Story

As a user writing a book, I want to get feedback on my writing. I'll write in the chat:

> "Naomi, check the current page and give me feedback on the writing"

Naomi will read the text, check style, consistency with characters, and give constructive feedback.

## What Should Happen

- User requests feedback in chat
- Naomi reads the content
- Naomi uses the knowledge base to check consistency
- Naomi gives detailed feedback with suggestions for improvement

## Example Requests

- "Naomi, are there consistency issues on this page?"
- "Naomi, check that the characters behave according to their defined traits"
- "Naomi, what do you think about the story pace in this chapter?"

## Technical Background

Implementation requires:
- Access to knowledge base (characters, locations, style)
- System prompt that defines Naomi as an editor
- Structured output for organized feedback
successCriteria: Chat request returns detailed feedback
Feedback addresses writing style
Naomi checks consistency with knowledge base
Improvement suggestions are clear and useful

challenges.title: Naomi Speaks English
challenges.description: As an English-speaking user, I want to use the app and chat with Naomi in English.
challenges.instructions:
## The Story

As a user who prefers English, I want:
- To see the interface in English
- To chat with Naomi in English
- Naomi to understand and respond to me in English

## What Should Happen

- Language switch button in interface
- Interface switches to English (LTR)
- Naomi detects user's language
- Naomi responds in the appropriate language

## Example Conversation in English

> User: "Naomi, add a new page about the character meeting a stranger"
> Naomi: "I'll add a new page to the current chapter. Here's what I wrote..."

## Technical Background

Implementation requires:
- i18n library (next-intl)
- Translation files for interface
- Passing selected language to Naomi's system prompt
successCriteria: Language switching in interface works
Interface displays in English/Hebrew based on choice
Naomi responds in the appropriate language
RTL/LTR changes based on language

techGuides.title: Project Overview
techGuides.description: Deep dive into AI Story Writer - a book writing app with an AI agent
techGuides.content:
# AI Story Writer - Complete Overview

## What is it?

A full application for writing books and stories with an AI agent named **Naomi**. The app is part of Singularity Bridge - a platform for learning AI development through real experiences.

## Key Principle: Everything Through Chat

**Important to understand:** The app is built around one idea - **all actions are performed through conversation with Naomi**.

Instead of edit, add, and delete buttons - the user simply asks Naomi:
- "Naomi, update this page - change the name to Dana"
- "Naomi, add a new page with a coffee shop scene"
- "Naomi, delete the last page"
- "Naomi, read me the story"

This is an AI Agent Experience - where AI does the work.

## Key Features

### 1. Book Library
- Grid display of 4 sample books
- Book cards with cover images
- Navigation to reading

### 2. Book Reader
- **3-panel layout**:
  - Left: Chapter and page navigation
  - Center: Page content
  - Right: Chat with Naomi
- Support for text and image pages
- Voice-over (through Naomi)

### 3. Knowledge Base
- **Characters**: Characters with traits, relationships, and backstory
- **Knowledge Items**: Information about locations, plot, world
- Naomi uses knowledge base to maintain consistency

### 4. Chat with Naomi
- **This is the core of the app**
- Naomi understands context (which book, chapter, page)
- Naomi can: edit, add, delete, read aloud
- Naomi uses knowledge base for consistency

## Project Structure

```
src/
├── app/
│   ├── page.tsx              # Home page
│   ├── book/
│   │   └── [id]/
│   │       ├── page.tsx      # Book reader + chat
│   │       └── knowledge/    # Knowledge base
│   ├── api/
│   │   └── book/[id]/route.ts
│   └── academy/              # The academy
├── components/
│   └── ChatAssistant.tsx     # Chat component
├── lib/
│   └── data.ts               # Data layer
└── data/
    └── db.json               # Database
```

## Data Models

### Book
- id, title, subtitle, description
- genre, author, coverImage

### Chapter
- id, bookId, title, order

### Page
- id, chapterId, type ('text' | 'image')
- title, content, order

### Character
- id, bookId, name, description
- role, traits[], backstory
- relationships[]

### KnowledgeItem
- id, bookId, title, content
- category, tags[]

## What to Implement in Academy

The UI is complete - what's missing is the AI connection:

- **ch-001**: Editing pages via chat
- **ch-002**: Adding pages via chat
- **ch-003**: Deleting pages via chat
- **ch-004**: Naomi continues the story
- **ch-005**: Voice reading via chat
- **ch-006**: Naomi reviews writing
- **ch-007**: Multi-language support

All challenges focus on **connecting Naomi to real AI** so she can perform actions.

techGuides.title: What is Vibe Coding?
techGuides.description: Learn about the new development approach with AI
techGuides.content:
# Vibe Coding - Development with AI

## What is it?

Vibe Coding is a development approach where you work **together** with AI as a coding partner.

## How does it work?

1. **Describe what you want** - in natural language

2. **AI suggests code** - review and learn

3. **Improve together** - iterate until it works

4. **Understand what happened** - learn from the process

## Recommended Tools

- **Claude Code** - from Anthropic

- **Cursor** - IDE with AI

- **GitHub Copilot** - Code suggestions

## Tips

- Provide sufficient context

- Ask questions

- Don't accept everything - verify!

- Learn from mistakes

techGuides.title: Introduction to MCP
techGuides.description: Model Context Protocol - how AI connects to tools
techGuides.content:
# MCP - Model Context Protocol

## What is it?

MCP is a protocol that allows AI models to connect to external tools and data sources.

## Why is it important?

- AI can access files
- AI can run commands
- AI can read from APIs

## Example

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "filesystem": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["@anthropic/mcp-server-filesystem", "/path"]
    }
  }
}
```

## Common MCP Servers

- **filesystem** - File access
- **github** - GitHub access
- **postgres** - DB access
- **brave-search** - Web search

techGuides.title: Singularity Bridge - Future Expansions
techGuides.description: Additional AI experiences and platform expansion directions
techGuides.content:
# Singularity Bridge - Future AI Experiences

## The Idea

Singularity Bridge is a platform for learning AI development through **real experiences**. Every app we build:
- Actually works (not just a demo)
- Teaches AI and development concepts
- Connected to an academy with challenges

## First Experience: AI Story Writer

Already exists! A story writer with:
- **Naomi** - AI agent for writing
- **Knowledge Base** - Knowledge base for characters and plot
- **Voice-over** - Voice reading

---

## Experiences Coming

### 1. AI Voice Assistant
**Type:** Interactive voice conversation

**Features:**
- Real-time conversation with AI
- Support for Hebrew and English
- Voice commands to perform actions
- Client-side function calling

**Technologies:**
- ElevenLabs Conversational AI
- VAPI Voice Agents
- OpenAI Realtime API

---

### 2. AI Image Studio
**Type:** Image creation and editing with AI

**Features:**
- Create images from text
- Edit existing images
- Style transfer
- Remove/add objects

**Technologies:**
- fal.ai FLUX models
- Stable Diffusion
- Controlnet for precise editing

---

### 3. AI Data Analyst
**Type:** Data analysis with conversation

**Features:**
- Upload CSV/Excel files
- Natural language questions
- Automatic chart creation
- Insights and summaries

**Technologies:**
- Code Interpreter (OpenAI)
- Claude Artifacts
- Chart.js / Recharts

---

### 4. AI Meeting Assistant
**Type:** Smart meeting helper

**Features:**
- Real-time transcription
- Automatic summary
- Action item detection
- Follow-up task creation

**Technologies:**
- Whisper for transcription
- GPT for summarization
- Calendar API

---

### 5. AI Form Builder
**Type:** Smart form building

**Features:**
- Create form from description
- Smart validation
- Auto-fill
- Multi-step wizard

**Technologies:**
- Structured Outputs
- Zod schemas
- React Hook Form

---

## Structure of Each Experience

Every app in Singularity Bridge will include:

```
/experience-name
├── README.md
├── /src
└── /academy
    ├── challenges/
    ├── guides/
    └── badges/
```

## Development Principles

1. **Real First** - Every app actually works
2. **Learn by Doing** - Learning through building
3. **Progressive** - Easy to complex
4. **Production Ready** - High quality code
